source_text: Situasi di lokasi jembatan sementara mengharuskan NFP [Titik Fokal Nasional] menjelaskan apakah pasang tinggi di dekat muara sungai mengubah urutan respons.
target_text: The situation in the temporary bridge site required NFP [National Focal Point] to clarify whether high tide near the river mouth changed the response sequence.

source_text: Setelah gempa bumi, tim HADR [Bantuan Kemanusiaan dan Penanggulangan Bencana] berfokus pada bantuan penyelamatan jiwa sebelum beralih ke pemulihan awal.
target_text: After the earthquake, HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] teams focused on life-saving assistance before shifting to early recovery.

source_text: Mitra regional berkoordinasi melalui Changi RHCC [Pusat Koordinasi HADR Regional Changi] ketika beberapa tawaran dukungan tiba sekaligus.
target_text: Regional partners coordinated through the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] when multiple offers of support arrived at once.

source_text: Pemerintah terdampak meminta dukungan angkat berat dari US INDOPACOM [Komando Indo-Pasifik Amerika Serikat] untuk komunitas pegunungan yang terisolasi.
target_text: The affected government requested heavy-lift support from US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] for isolated mountain communities.

source_text: Catatan penghubung dari PLA [Tentara Pembebasan Rakyat] menjelaskan bagaimana tawaran mitra harus diurutkan sebelum dukungan mitra bergerak menuju komune utara.
target_text: A liaison note from PLA [People's Liberation Army] clarified how partner offers should be sequenced before partner support moved toward the northern communes.

source_text: Pembaruan situasi dari AHA Centre [Pusat Koordinasi ASEAN untuk Bantuan Kemanusiaan dalam penanggulangan bencana] membantu menyelaraskan prioritas bantuan di antara mitra ASEAN.
target_text: Situation updates from the AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] helped align relief priorities across ASEAN partners.

source_text: Kementerian pemerintah dan lembaga kemanusiaan bergabung dalam panggilan koordinasi yang diselenggarakan oleh UN OCHA [Kantor Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa untuk Koordinasi Urusan Kemanusiaan].
target_text: Government ministries and humanitarian agencies joined the coordination call hosted by UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: Di distrik yang rusak, ASEAN-ERAT [Tim Tanggap Darurat dan Penilaian ASEAN] memverifikasi kebutuhan tempat penampungan sebelum pasokan tambahan dikirim.
target_text: In the damaged district, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] verified shelter needs before additional supplies were dispatched.

source_text: Papan penugasan mencatat ACMC [Pusat Sipil-Militer Australia] sebagai kontak koordinasi utama untuk dukungan tempat penampungan di koridor jalan pegunungan.
target_text: The tasking board recorded ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] as the key coordination contact for shelter support in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: Petugas distrik mengaitkan ToR [Kerangka Acuan] dengan jendela distribusi yang direvisi setelah laporan dari dusun-dusun pulau sungai berubah semalam.
target_text: district officers linked ToR [Terms of Reference] to a revised distribution window after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: Klaster kesehatan meminta WHO [Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia] meninjau rencana surveilans penyakit.
target_text: The health cluster asked WHO [World Health Organization] to review the disease surveillance plan.

source_text: Otoritas lokal berkoordinasi dengan WFP [Program Pangan Dunia] untuk mengirim paket pangan ke pusat-pusat evakuasi.
target_text: Local authorities coordinated with WFP [World Food Programme] to deliver food packages to evacuation centres.

source_text: Petugas logistik menerapkan ToR [Kerangka Acuan] ketika puing-puing tidak aman di dekat gudang membuat perencanaan untuk area gudang provinsi kurang dapat diprediksi.
target_text: logistics clerks applied ToR [Terms of Reference] when unsafe debris near a warehouse made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: Hibah tempat penampungan darurat ditinjau oleh USAID BHA [Biro Bantuan Kemanusiaan Badan Pembangunan Internasional Amerika Serikat] selama rapat koordinasi donor.
target_text: Emergency shelter grants were reviewed by USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] during the donor coordination meeting.

source_text: Pejabat pertahanan regional membahas kesiapsiagaan HADR di bawah kerangka ADMM-Plus [Pertemuan Menteri Pertahanan ASEAN Plus].
target_text: Regional defence officials discussed HADR readiness under the ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] framework.

source_text: Pelajaran dari EWG on HADR [Kelompok Kerja Pakar tentang Bantuan Kemanusiaan dan Penanggulangan Bencana] ditambahkan ke matriks evaluasi latihan.
target_text: Lessons from the EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] were added to the exercise evaluation matrix.

source_text: Pemimpin tim penyelamat memeriksa panduan INSARAG [Kelompok Penasihat Pencarian dan Penyelamatan Internasional] sebelum menugaskan sektor pencarian.
target_text: The rescue team leader checked INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] guidance before assigning search sectors.

source_text: Catatan rapat diteruskan melalui ASEAN Secretariat [badan administrasi pusat ASEAN] untuk distribusi resmi.
target_text: Meeting notes were routed through the ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] for official distribution.

source_text: Unit medis dan teknik yang dapat dikerahkan didaftarkan oleh AMRG on HADR [Kelompok Militer ASEAN Siap untuk HADR].
target_text: Deployable medical and engineering units were catalogued by the AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR].

source_text: Negara tuan rumah meminta dukungan pemurnian air dari SAF [Angkatan Bersenjata Singapura] setelah sumur terkontaminasi.
target_text: The host nation requested water purification support from SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] after wells were contaminated.

source_text: Peralatan teknik dari PLA [Tentara Pembebasan Rakyat] ditugaskan untuk memulihkan akses ke penyeberangan sungai.
target_text: Engineering equipment from the PLA [People's Liberation Army] was assigned to restore access to the river crossing.

source_text: Penugasan regional harian dikoordinasikan melalui JOCCA [Pusat Operasi dan Koordinasi Bersama ASEAN] selama periode puncak respons.
target_text: Daily regional tasking was coordinated through JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] during the peak response period.

source_text: Prosedur pencarian struktur runtuh diperagakan oleh SCDF [Angkatan Pertahanan Sipil Singapura] selama latihan lapangan.
target_text: Collapsed-structure search procedures were demonstrated by SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] during the field drill.

source_text: Pos komando nasional melaporkan semua tawaran internasional kepada VINASARCOM [Komite Pengarah Nasional Vietnam untuk Pertahanan Sipil].
target_text: The national command post reported all international offers to VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].

source_text: Prioritas pertahanan banjir dari VDDMA [Otoritas Penanggulangan Bencana dan Tanggul Vietnam] membentuk alokasi pompa dan karung pasir.
target_text: Flood defence priorities from VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] shaped the allocation of pumps and sandbags.

source_text: Dukungan perbaikan jembatan diberikan oleh insinyur VPA [Tentara Rakyat Vietnam] setelah rute pasokan utama gagal.
target_text: Bridge repair support was provided by VPA [Vietnam People's Army] engineers after the main supply route failed.

source_text: Data kerugian pertanian dari MARD [Kementerian Pertanian dan Pembangunan Pedesaan] menjadi dasar perencanaan pemulihan awal.
target_text: Agricultural loss data from MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] informed early recovery planning.

source_text: Pembaruan pembersihan jalan dari MOT [Kementerian Transportasi] ditambahkan ke gambaran operasi bersama.
target_text: Road clearance updates from MOT [Ministry of Transport] were added to the common operating picture.

source_text: Prioritas evakuasi medis disetujui oleh MOH [Kementerian Kesehatan] sebelum helikopter diberangkatkan.
target_text: Medical evacuation priorities were approved by MOH [Ministry of Health] before helicopters launched.

source_text: Mitra pemulihan di bawah DRRP [Kemitraan Pengurangan Risiko Bencana Vietnam] mengidentifikasi komune prioritas untuk program ketangguhan.
target_text: Recovery partners under DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] identified priority communes for resilience programming.

source_text: Pesan kesiapsiagaan yang didukung oleh QPT [Dana Komunitas untuk Pencegahan Bencana Alam] menjangkau rumah tangga di area rawan longsor.
target_text: Preparedness messaging supported by QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] reached households in landslide-prone areas.

source_text: Tim pertolongan pertama dari VNRC [Palang Merah Vietnam] membantu pengungsi lanjut usia di tempat penampungan sekolah.
target_text: First aid teams from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] assisted elderly evacuees at the school shelter.

source_text: Laporan kesiapan rumah sakit dari VAMS [Administrasi Layanan Medis Vietnam] dibagikan selama pengarahan kesehatan malam.
target_text: Hospital readiness reports from VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] were shared during the evening health briefing.

source_text: Serah terima operasional menggunakan format WoG [Seluruh Pemerintahan] untuk menggabungkan pembaruan distrik pesisir dari pejabat transportasi, kesehatan, dan pertahanan.
target_text: The operational handover used a WoG [Whole-of-Government] format to combine coastal district updates from transport, health, and defence officials.

source_text: Mitra internasional menunggu NDMO [Kantor Nasional Penanggulangan Bencana] mengonfirmasi daftar kebutuhan resmi.
target_text: International partners waited for the NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] to confirm the official needs list.

source_text: Ketika pembaruan dari ibu kota provinsi saling bertentangan, CMCoord [Koordinasi Sipil-Militer] memberi perencana cara yang lebih jelas untuk membandingkan prioritas.
target_text: When updates from the provincial capital conflicted, CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] gave planners a clearer way to compare priorities.

source_text: Perencana meninjau Mil-Mil [koordinasi Militer-ke-Militer] sebelum menetapkan tanggung jawab distribusi bantuan selama siklus koordinasi pagi.
target_text: Planners reviewed Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] before assigning responsibility for relief distribution during the morning coordination cycle.

source_text: Tim respons meninjau Civ-Mil [koordinasi Sipil-Militer] setelah pengulang radio yang rusak menunjukkan kelemahan dalam perencanaan untuk lokasi jembatan sementara.
target_text: The response team reviewed Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the temporary bridge site.

source_text: Ketika tim kesehatan masyarakat melaporkan pasang tinggi di dekat muara sungai, AS [Affected State] menjadi acuan untuk area pencarian yang lebih sempit.
target_text: When public health teams reported high tide near the river mouth, AS [Affected State] became the reference point for a narrower search area.

source_text: MNCC [Pusat Koordinasi Multinasional] memberikan konteks yang hilang setelah pimpinan penilaian mempertanyakan laporan dari jalan pintas perbukitan.
target_text: MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] provided the missing context after assessment leads questioned reports from the hill road bypass.

source_text: Laporan distrik mencapai EOC [Pusat Operasi Darurat] sebelum pengarahan nasional dimulai.
target_text: District reports reached the EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] before the national briefing began.

source_text: Provinsi mengajukan RFA [Permintaan Bantuan] untuk unit pengolahan air dan tim medis bergerak.
target_text: The province submitted an RFA [Request for Assistance] for water treatment units and mobile medical teams.

source_text: Angka hunian tempat penampungan ditambahkan ke COP [Common Operating Picture] sebelum pembaruan komandan.
target_text: Shelter occupancy figures were added to the COP [Common Operating Picture] before the commanders' update.

source_text: Tim meninjau kembali SAR [Pencarian dan Penyelamatan] karena kekurangan awak ambulans memengaruhi cara perwakilan donor merencanakan pembaruan komandan yang lebih singkat.
target_text: The team revisited SAR [Search and Rescue] because a shortage of ambulance crews affected how donor representatives planned a shorter commander update.

source_text: Blok apartemen yang runtuh memerlukan tambahan anjing USAR [Pencarian dan Penyelamatan Perkotaan] serta peralatan pencarian teknis.
target_text: The collapsed apartment block required additional USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] dogs and technical search equipment.

source_text: Tim respons meninjau AS [Affected State] setelah pengulang radio yang rusak menunjukkan kelemahan dalam perencanaan untuk sabuk evakuasi utara.
target_text: The response team reviewed AS [Affected State] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the northern evacuation belt.

source_text: Sebelum pembersihan puing dimulai, para petugas respons memeriksa apakah bahaya CBRE [dampak Kimia, Biologi, Radiologi, dan Ledakan] ada.
target_text: Before debris clearance began, responders checked whether CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] hazards were present.

source_text: Ketika longsor lumpur di atas jalan pintas muncul, PLA [Tentara Pembebasan Rakyat] bekerja dengan pengawas penyelamatan pada tim penilaian yang lebih kecil di kota pasar dataran rendah.
target_text: When mudslides above the bypass emerged, PLA [People's Liberation Army] worked with rescue supervisors on a smaller assessment team in a low-lying market town.

source_text: Jamban darurat dan titik air bersih dikelompokkan di bawah WASH [Air, Sanitasi, dan Higiene] dalam rencana sektor.
target_text: Emergency latrines and clean water points were grouped under WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] in the sector plan.

source_text: Selimut, tikar tidur, dan perlengkapan dapur dicatat sebagai stok NFI [Barang Non-Pangan].
target_text: Blankets, sleeping mats, and kitchen sets were recorded as NFI [Non-Food Items] stocks.

source_text: HOC [Pusat Operasi Kemanusiaan] memberikan pembaruan terfokus tentang kerusakan jembatan, yang membantu tim menyesuaikan prioritas untuk pangkalan persiapan sementara.
target_text: HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] contributed a focused update on bridge damage, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: Manajer gudang melaporkan kekurangan bahan bakar dan truk kepada LCC [Pusat Koordinasi Logistik].
target_text: Warehouse managers reported fuel and truck shortages to the LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre].

source_text: Tim meninjau kembali COP [Common Operating Picture] karena gorong-gorong yang tersumbat di dekat MSR memengaruhi cara manajer gudang merencanakan catatan prioritas sektor yang seimbang.
target_text: The team revisited COP [Common Operating Picture] because a blocked culvert near the MSR affected how warehouse managers planned a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Latihan rumah sakit meningkat menjadi skenario MASCAS [Insiden Korban Massal] dengan pasien trauma simulasi.
target_text: The hospital drill escalated into a MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] scenario with simulated trauma patients.

source_text: Tim penyelamat yang masuk mendapat manfaat dari Mutual Recognition [perjanjian sertifikasi untuk tim USAR] selama proses pengerahan.
target_text: Incoming rescue teams benefited from Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] during the deployment process.

source_text: Kargo bantuan bergerak melalui APOD [Pelabuhan Udara Kedatangan] sebelum diangkut dengan truk ke pedalaman.
target_text: Relief cargo moved through the APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] before being trucked inland.

source_text: Tim logistik memindahkan alat berat melalui SPOD [Pelabuhan Laut Kedatangan] untuk mengurangi kemacetan lapangan udara.
target_text: The logistics team shifted heavy equipment through the SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] to reduce airfield congestion.

source_text: Para insinyur membuka kembali MSR [Rute Pasokan Utama] yang menghubungkan gudang provinsi dengan area evakuasi.
target_text: Engineers reopened the MSR [Main Supply Route] linking the provincial warehouse to the evacuation area.

source_text: Petugas respons yang masuk menyelesaikan pemeriksaan CIQ [Bea Cukai, Imigrasi, dan Karantina] sebelum bergerak ke pangkalan persiapan.
target_text: Incoming responders completed CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] checks before moving to the staging base.

source_text: Pemerintah menerima dukungan MCDA [Aset Militer dan Pertahanan Sipil] untuk transportasi, teknik, dan evakuasi medis.
target_text: The government accepted MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] support for transport, engineering, and medical evacuation.

source_text: Prioritas kemanusiaan dilindungi dengan menggunakan HuMOCC [Konsep Koordinasi Operasional Kemanusiaan-Militer] sebagai acuan koordinasi.
target_text: Humanitarian priorities were protected by using HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] as the coordination reference.

source_text: Polisi, spesialis forensik, dan staf kesehatan membentuk kelompok koordinasi DVI [Identifikasi Korban Bencana].
target_text: Police, forensic specialists, and health staff formed the DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] coordination group.

source_text: Pemimpin desa memberi tahu LEMA [Otoritas Manajemen Darurat Lokal] bahwa satu tempat penampungan telah kehabisan air minum.
target_text: Village leaders informed LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] that one shelter had run out of drinking water.

source_text: Peserta Ex COORES [Latihan Respons Terkoordinasi] mempraktikkan pengambilan keputusan dalam skenario bencana regional yang realistis.
target_text: Participants in Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] practiced decision-making under a realistic regional disaster scenario.

source_text: Petugas penghubung menerapkan TTX [Latihan Meja] ketika ketidakpastian batas berat jalan membuat perencanaan untuk area gudang provinsi kurang dapat diprediksi.
target_text: liaison officers applied TTX [Table-Top Exercise] when uncertain road weight limits made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: Tim respons meninjau OPERA CIS [Sistem Informasi Komputer untuk berbagi informasi] setelah sekelompok kasus demam menunjukkan kelemahan dalam perencanaan untuk penyeberangan feri yang rusak.
target_text: The response team reviewed OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] after a cluster of fever cases exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: Pejabat memeriksa SASOP [Prosedur Operasi Standar untuk Pengaturan Siaga Regional] sebelum meminta aset siaga regional.
target_text: Officials checked SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] before requesting regional standby assets.

source_text: Pengerahan aset militer ditinjau berdasarkan SASOP Chapter VI [bagian yang mengatur fasilitasi dan penggunaan aset militer] selama skenario.
target_text: Military asset deployment was reviewed against SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] during the scenario.

source_text: Penasihat hukum mengutip AADMER [Perjanjian ASEAN tentang Penanggulangan Bencana dan Tanggap Darurat] ketika menjelaskan mekanisme respons bencana ASEAN.
target_text: The legal advisor cited AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] when explaining ASEAN disaster response mechanisms.

source_text: Tim desain skenario mengadaptasi sisipan ARDEX [Latihan Simulasi Tanggap Darurat Bencana Regional ASEAN] untuk latihan respons banjir.
target_text: The scenario design team adapted an ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] inject for the flood response exercise.

source_text: SME [Pakar Subjek] logistik memperingatkan bahwa pelabuhan dapat menjadi titik kemacetan dalam hitungan jam.
target_text: The logistics SME [Subject Matter Expert] warned that the port could become a bottleneck within hours.

source_text: Selama AAR [Tinjauan Setelah Aksi], peserta mencatat bahwa petugas penghubung membutuhkan catatan serah terima yang lebih jelas.
target_text: During the AAR [After Action Review], participants noted that liaison officers needed clearer handover notes.

source_text: Laporan yang disusun dengan GenAI [Kecerdasan Buatan Generatif] tetap memerlukan peninjauan oleh staf operasional manusia.
target_text: Reports drafted with GenAI [Generative AI] still required review by human operational staff.

source_text: Pembaruan malam memasukkan PLA [Tentara Pembebasan Rakyat] karena umpan balik komunitas memengaruhi perencanaan lokal dan koordinasi regional.
target_text: The evening update included PLA [People's Liberation Army] because community feedback affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: Peta banjir yang diturunkan dari Sentinel-1 [program pencitraan satelit] membantu memastikan jalan mana yang masih dapat dilalui.
target_text: Flood maps derived from Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] helped confirm which roads were still passable.

source_text: Linimasa respons disesuaikan berdasarkan Copernicus [program pencitraan satelit] setelah kerusakan jembatan memengaruhi komunitas di desa-desa hilir.
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] once bridge damage affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: Tim respons meninjau Digital Twin [proyek replika virtual yang diusulkan untuk akurasi simulasi] setelah daftar penerima manfaat yang hilang menunjukkan kelemahan dalam perencanaan untuk titik kumpul komune terpencil.
target_text: The response team reviewed Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] after a missing beneficiary list exposed a weakness in planning for the remote commune assembly point.

source_text: Ringkasan koordinasi mengutip masukan dari MOT [Kementerian Transportasi] setelah gangguan telekomunikasi mengubah asumsi respons.
target_text: The coordination brief cited inputs from MOT [Ministry of Transport] after telecommunications outages changed the response assumptions.

source_text: Sel perencanaan menggunakan Interoperability [kemampuan berbagai sistem untuk bertukar data] untuk memutuskan apakah desa-desa nelayan pesisir memerlukan ringkasan keputusan yang lebih sederhana.
target_text: The planning cell used Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a simpler decision brief.

source_text: Untuk koridor longsor dataran tinggi, Information Overload [tantangan mengelola volume data tinggi selama puncak dampak] memberi tim cara untuk membandingkan kekurangan awak ambulans dengan risiko respons lainnya.
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] gave the team a way to compare a shortage of ambulance crews with other response risks.

source_text: Sel koordinasi memperbarui ToR [Kerangka Acuan] setelah petugas penghubung baru tiba.
target_text: The coordination cell updated its ToR [Terms of Reference] after new liaison officers arrived.

source_text: Komandan memaparkan CONOPS [Konsep Operasi] sebelum menugaskan tugas kepada unit mitra.
target_text: The commander briefed the CONOPS [Concept of Operations] before assigning tasks to partner units.

source_text: Setiap tawaran bantuan diteruskan melalui NFP [Titik Fokal Nasional] sebelum diterima.
target_text: Every offer of assistance was routed through the NFP [National Focal Point] before acceptance.

source_text: Petugas penghubung menerapkan HADR [Bantuan Kemanusiaan dan Penanggulangan Bencana] ketika sekelompok kasus demam membuat perencanaan untuk wilayah tangkapan rumah sakit timur kurang dapat diprediksi.
target_text: liaison officers applied HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] when a cluster of fever cases made planning for the eastern hospital catchment less predictable.

source_text: Pejabat distrik berkonsultasi dengan Changi RHCC [Pusat Koordinasi HADR Regional Changi] sambil merekonsiliasi laporan tempat penampungan dengan kendala akses di area pelabuhan yang rusak.
target_text: District officials consulted Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the damaged port area.

source_text: Sebelum menyetujui paket dukungan berikutnya, perencana meminta US INDOPACOM [Komando Indo-Pasifik Amerika Serikat] memastikan di mana waktu distribusi perlu disesuaikan.
target_text: Before approving the next support package, planners asked US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] to confirm where distribution timing needed adjustment.

source_text: Catatan penghubung dari CFE-DM [Pusat Keunggulan dalam Manajemen Bencana dan Bantuan Kemanusiaan] menjelaskan permintaan mana yang telah divalidasi sebelum dukungan mitra bergerak menuju permukiman dataran banjir.
target_text: A liaison note from CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the floodplain settlements.

source_text: Pembaruan malam memasukkan AHA Centre [Pusat Koordinasi ASEAN untuk Bantuan Kemanusiaan dalam penanggulangan bencana] karena pergerakan populasi yang tidak pasti memengaruhi perencanaan lokal dan koordinasi regional.
target_text: The evening update included AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] because uncertain population movement affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: Setelah tim lapangan melaporkan kepadatan tempat penampungan, UN OCHA [Kantor Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa untuk Koordinasi Urusan Kemanusiaan] membantu menyempurnakan permintaan dukungan untuk komune utara.
target_text: After field teams reported shelter crowding, UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs] helped refine the support request for the northern communes.

source_text: ASEAN-ERAT [Tim Tanggap Darurat dan Penilaian ASEAN] bergabung dalam pembahasan untuk memvalidasi apakah penerbangan bantuan yang tertunda telah mengubah jadwal penilaian.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] joined the discussion to validate whether delayed relief flights had changed the assessment schedule.

source_text: Pejabat distrik berkonsultasi dengan ACMC [Pusat Sipil-Militer Australia] sambil merekonsiliasi laporan tempat penampungan dengan kendala akses di ibu kota provinsi.

source_text: Ketika skenario banjir meluas ke tiga provinsi, AHA Centre [Pusat Koordinasi ASEAN untuk Bantuan Kemanusiaan dalam penanggulangan bencana] membantu mengonsolidasikan opsi dukungan ASEAN ke dalam satu gambaran koordinasi regional.
target_text: When the flood scenario expanded across three provinces, the AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] helped consolidate ASEAN support options into a single regional coordination picture.

source_text: Tim kemanusiaan negara mengandalkan UN OCHA [Kantor Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa untuk Koordinasi Urusan Kemanusiaan] untuk menghubungkan pimpinan sektor, perwakilan donor, dan pejabat pemerintah selama pengarahan operasional pertama.
target_text: The humanitarian country team relied on UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs] to connect sector leads, donor representatives, and government officials during the first operational briefing.

source_text: Setelah mencapai komune yang rusak, ASEAN-ERAT [Tim Tanggap Darurat dan Penilaian ASEAN] membandingkan wawancara komunitas dengan citra satelit sebelum merekomendasikan dukungan tempat penampungan dan WASH yang mendesak.
target_text: After reaching the damaged commune, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] compared community interviews with satellite imagery before recommending urgent shelter and WASH support.

source_text: Untuk klaster tempat penampungan sekolah, perencana provinsi menggunakan masukan dari ACMC [Pusat Sipil-Militer Australia] untuk memilih paket bea cukai yang lebih cepat alih-alih respons yang luas.
target_text: For the school shelter cluster, provincial planners used inputs from ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] to choose a faster customs package instead of a broad response.

source_text: Dengan menggunakan prakiraan curah hujan dan lapisan paparan populasi, analis PDC [Pusat Bencana Pasifik] mengidentifikasi distrik dataran rendah mana yang kemungkinan memerlukan evakuasi dalam empat puluh delapan jam.
target_text: Using rainfall forecasts and population exposure layers, PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] analysts identified which low-lying districts were likely to require evacuation within forty-eight hours.

source_text: Sebelum menyetujui paket dukungan berikutnya, perencana meminta WHO [Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia] memastikan bagaimana angka tempat penampungan telah berubah.
target_text: Before approving the next support package, planners asked WHO [World Health Organization] to confirm how shelter figures had changed.

source_text: Untuk menjaga pasokan tempat penampungan terpencil, WFP [Program Pangan Dunia] mengoordinasikan truk, pelepasan gudang, dan titik distribusi lokal melalui mekanisme koordinasi logistik.
target_text: To keep remote shelters supplied, WFP [World Food Programme] coordinated trucks, warehouse releases, and local distribution points through the logistics coordination mechanism.

source_text: Petugas distrik meminta ISCG [Kelompok Koordinasi Antar-Sektor] memverifikasi ketidakpastian batas berat jalan sebelum mengalokasikan sumber daya ke pos komando distrik.
target_text: district officers asked ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] to verify uncertain road weight limits before committing resources to the district command post.

source_text: Staf operasional menggunakan saran dari USAID BHA [Biro Bantuan Kemanusiaan Badan Pembangunan Internasional Amerika Serikat] untuk menentukan rute mana yang dapat mendukung kendaraan berat tanpa menunda bantuan ke jaringan pusat evakuasi.
target_text: Operational staff used advice from USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] to resolve which routes could support heavy vehicles without delaying assistance to the evacuation centre network.

source_text: Di forum pertahanan regional, peserta ADMM-Plus [Pertemuan Menteri Pertahanan ASEAN Plus] membahas bagaimana aset militer dapat mendukung respons bencana tanpa menggantikan struktur koordinasi sipil.
target_text: At the regional defence forum, ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] participants discussed how military assets could support disaster response without replacing civilian coordination structures.

source_text: Perencana melibatkan EWG on HADR [Kelompok Kerja Pakar tentang Bantuan Kemanusiaan dan Penanggulangan Bencana] dalam pembahasan setelah kepadatan tempat penampungan mulai memengaruhi pergerakan bantuan berikutnya.
target_text: Planners brought EWG on HADR [Experts Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] into the discussion once shelter crowding began affecting the next relief movement.

source_text: Sebelum tim penyelamat internasional tiba, panduan INSARAG [Kelompok Penasihat Pencarian dan Penyelamatan Internasional] membantu negara tuan rumah menetapkan prosedur penerimaan dan mengalokasikan sektor pencarian struktur runtuh.
target_text: Before international rescue teams arrived, INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] guidance helped the host nation establish reception procedures and allocate collapsed-structure search sectors.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat [badan administrasi pusat ASEAN] memberikan konteks yang hilang setelah staf lapangan udara mempertanyakan laporan dari titik kumpul komune terpencil.
target_text: ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] provided the missing context after airfield staff questioned reports from the remote commune assembly point.

source_text: AMRG on HADR [Kelompok Militer ASEAN Siap untuk HADR] memberikan pembaruan terfokus tentang keterlambatan pembersihan jalan, yang membantu tim menyesuaikan prioritas untuk komunitas pulau.
target_text: AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR] contributed a focused update on road clearance delays, which helped the team adjust priorities for the island communities.

source_text: Selama skenario gangguan pelabuhan, perencana SAF [Angkatan Bersenjata Singapura] menawarkan paket pemurnian air dan tim penghubung komando kecil untuk dukungan koordinasi.
target_text: During the port disruption scenario, SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] planners offered a water purification package and a small command liaison team for coordination support.

source_text: Pembaruan malam memasukkan PLA [Tentara Pembebasan Rakyat] karena data penilaian yang terlambat memengaruhi perencanaan lokal dan koordinasi regional.
target_text: The evening update included PLA [People's Liberation Army] because late assessment data affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: Setelah tim lapangan melaporkan keterlambatan pelabuhan, JOCCA [Pusat Operasi dan Koordinasi Bersama ASEAN] membantu menyempurnakan permintaan dukungan untuk ibu kota provinsi.
target_text: After field teams reported port delays, JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] helped refine the support request for the provincial capital.

source_text: SCDF [Angkatan Pertahanan Sipil Singapura] menyesuaikan rencana persiapan tim penyelamatnya ketika kemacetan gudang memperlambat pergerakan peralatan teknis.
target_text: SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] adjusted its rescue-team staging plan when warehouse congestion slowed the movement of technical equipment.

source_text: Catatan lapangan dari VINASARCOM [Komite Pengarah Nasional Vietnam untuk Pertahanan Sipil] menyaring perencanaan untuk kota pasar dataran rendah, menghasilkan tim penilaian yang lebih kecil.
target_text: A field note from VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense] screened planning for a low-lying market town, leading to a smaller assessment team.

source_text: Ketika permukaan sungai kembali naik, insinyur VDDMA [Otoritas Penanggulangan Bencana dan Tanggul Vietnam] menilai ulang stabilitas tanggul dan memperingatkan EOC bahwa evakuasi hilir mungkin diperlukan.
target_text: When river levels rose again, VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] engineers reassessed dyke stability and warned the EOC that downstream evacuations might be required.

source_text: VPA [Tentara Rakyat Vietnam] memberikan pembaruan terfokus tentang kekhawatiran surveilans penyakit, yang membantu tim menyesuaikan prioritas untuk pangkalan persiapan sementara.
target_text: VPA [Vietnam People's Army] contributed a focused update on disease surveillance concerns, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: Ketika lonjakan hujan malam hari muncul, MARD [Kementerian Pertanian dan Pembangunan Pedesaan] bekerja dengan otoritas pelabuhan pada tugas penyediaan air yang praktis di apron kargo bandara.
target_text: When a night-time rainfall surge emerged, MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] worked with port authorities on a practical water-supply task in the airport cargo apron.

source_text: Staf operasional menggunakan saran dari MOT [Kementerian Transportasi] untuk menentukan aset mana yang dapat dikerahkan cepat tanpa menunda bantuan ke komunitas pulau.
target_text: Operational staff used advice from MOT [Ministry of Transport] to resolve which assets could deploy quickly without delaying assistance to the island communities.

source_text: MOH [Kementerian Kesehatan] menjadi kontak utama untuk pemeriksaan kesehatan tempat penampungan setelah tim klinik melaporkan peningkatan penyakit di distrik pesisir.
target_text: MOH [Ministry of Health] became the lead contact for shelter health checks after clinic teams reported rising illness in the coastal district.

source_text: Pejabat transportasi melibatkan DRRP [Kemitraan Pengurangan Risiko Bencana Vietnam] dalam pembahasan karena jalan akses pelabuhan membutuhkan tim penilaian yang lebih kecil.
target_text: transport officials brought DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] into the discussion because the port access road needed a smaller assessment team.

source_text: Ringkasan koordinasi mengutip masukan dari QPT [Dana Komunitas untuk Pencegahan Bencana Alam] setelah penumpukan ambulans mengubah asumsi respons.
target_text: The coordination brief cited inputs from QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] after ambulance backlogs changed the response assumptions.

source_text: VNRC [Palang Merah Vietnam] memberikan pembaruan terfokus tentang keterlambatan pemrosesan bea cukai, yang membantu tim menyesuaikan prioritas untuk jaringan pusat evakuasi.
target_text: VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] contributed a focused update on customs processing delays, which helped the team adjust priorities for the evacuation centre network.

source_text: Catatan lapangan dari VAMS [Administrasi Layanan Medis Vietnam] memperbarui perencanaan untuk kawasan industri yang rusak akibat banjir, menghasilkan tugas penyediaan air yang praktis.
target_text: A field note from VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] updated planning for the flood-damaged industrial estate, leading to a practical water-supply task.

source_text: WoG [Seluruh Pemerintahan] membentuk tugas teknik yang lebih realistis setelah pengawas tempat penampungan memastikan kondisi di koridor logistik barat.
target_text: WoG [Whole-of-Government] shaped a more realistic engineering task once shelter supervisors confirmed conditions in the western logistics corridor.

source_text: NDMO [Kantor Nasional Penanggulangan Bencana] menggunakan pembaruan ruang operasi distrik untuk memastikan permintaan tempat penampungan mana yang masih membutuhkan dukungan eksternal.
target_text: The NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] used the district operations room update to confirm which shelter requests still needed external support.

source_text: Tinjauan singkat atas CMCoord [Koordinasi Sipil-Militer] membantu perencana medis menafsirkan angka populasi desa yang saling bertentangan tanpa menunda rute konvoi yang lebih aman.
target_text: A short review of CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] helped medical planners interpret conflicting village population figures without delaying a safer convoy route.

source_text: Saluran Mil-Mil [koordinasi Militer-ke-Militer] membantu pasukan mitra membandingkan ketersediaan transportasi medis untuk distrik pesisir.
target_text: Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] channels helped partner forces compare medical transport availability for the coastal district.

source_text: Selama rapat Civ-Mil [koordinasi Sipil-Militer] harian, LSM menjelaskan kendala distribusi sementara perencana militer menjelaskan kapasitas angkut yang tersedia dan jadwal pembersihan rute.
target_text: During the daily Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] meeting, NGOs explained distribution constraints while military planners described available lift capacity and route-clearance timelines.

source_text: Karena AS [Affected State] mempertahankan kendali kedaulatan atas respons, semua tim eksternal menunggu persetujuan nasional sebelum bergerak melampaui area persiapan.
target_text: Because the AS [Affected State] retained sovereign control of the response, all external teams waited for national approval before moving beyond staging areas.

source_text: Sebelum dukungan bergerak menuju klaster tempat penampungan sekolah, MNCC [Pusat Koordinasi Multinasional] membantu manajer gudang memeriksa pasang tinggi di dekat muara sungai terhadap laporan lapangan.
target_text: Before support moved toward the school shelter cluster, MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] helped warehouse managers check high tide near the river mouth against field reports.

source_text: Di dalam EOC [Pusat Operasi Darurat], staf melacak pemadaman listrik, laporan korban, populasi tempat penampungan, kondisi jalan, dan permintaan mendesak dari otoritas distrik.
target_text: Inside the EOC [Emergency Operations Centre], staff tracked power outages, casualty reports, shelter populations, road conditions, and urgent requests from district authorities.

source_text: Otoritas provinsi mengirim RFA [Permintaan Bantuan] untuk generator, unit pemurnian air, dan jembatan sementara setelah sumber daya lokal habis.
target_text: The provincial authority sent an RFA [Request for Assistance] for generators, water purification units, and temporary bridges after local resources were exhausted.

source_text: Linimasa respons disesuaikan berdasarkan COP [Common Operating Picture] setelah kekhawatiran surveilans penyakit memengaruhi komunitas di desa-desa hilir.
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around COP [Common Operating Picture] once disease surveillance concerns affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: Ketika petugas penghubung melaporkan lonjakan hujan malam hari, SAR [Pencarian dan Penyelamatan] menjadi acuan untuk catatan serah terima yang lebih baik.
target_text: When liaison officers reported a night-time rainfall surge, SAR [Search and Rescue] became the reference point for a better handover note.

source_text: Selama pengarahan malam, USAR [Pencarian dan Penyelamatan Perkotaan] membentuk cara tim mengorganisasi laporan dari ruang operasi distrik.
target_text: During the evening briefing, USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] shaped how teams organized reports from the district operations room.

source_text: Untuk area pemukiman kembali selatan, MSAR [Pencarian dan Penyelamatan Maritim] memberi tim cara untuk membandingkan laporan terlambat tentang sumur yang terkontaminasi dengan risiko respons lainnya.
target_text: For the southern resettlement area, MSAR [Maritime Search and Rescue] gave the team a way to compare late reports of contaminated wells with other response risks.

source_text: Catatan koordinasi merujuk pada CBRE [dampak Kimia, Biologi, Radiologi, dan Ledakan] setelah kekhawatiran surveilans penyakit menunjukkan celah dalam proses respons.
target_text: The coordination note referenced CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] after disease surveillance concerns exposed a gap in the response process.

source_text: Para pemimpin senior meninjau IOI [Isu-isu Kepentingan] seperti kekurangan bahan bakar, kemacetan helikopter, kepadatan tempat penampungan, dan keterlambatan bea cukai sebelum mengeluarkan panduan baru.
target_text: Senior leaders reviewed IOI [Issues of Interest] such as fuel shortages, helicopter congestion, shelter overcrowding, and customs delays before issuing new guidance.

source_text: Tim meninjau kembali WASH [Air, Sanitasi, dan Higiene] karena sekelompok kasus demam memengaruhi cara pengawas tempat penampungan merencanakan kunjungan tempat penampungan yang terarah.
target_text: The team revisited WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] because a cluster of fever cases affected how shelter supervisors planned a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: Di desa-desa nelayan pesisir, NFI [Barang Non-Pangan] membantu mengubah daftar penerima manfaat yang hilang menjadi permintaan pergerakan udara yang direvisi.
target_text: In coastal fishing villages, NFI [Non-Food Items] helped convert a missing beneficiary list into a revised air movement request.

source_text: Manajer gudang berkoordinasi dengan HOC [Pusat Operasi Kemanusiaan] setelah pemadaman listrik di EOC mengancam mengganggu dukungan untuk koridor longsor dataran tinggi.
target_text: warehouse managers coordinated with HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] after a power outage at the EOC threatened to disrupt support for the upland landslide corridor.

source_text: Ketika pemeriksaan jembatan yang tertunda muncul, LCC [Pusat Koordinasi Logistik] bekerja dengan pejabat transportasi pada catatan prioritas sektor yang seimbang di kota pasar dataran rendah.
target_text: When a delayed bridge inspection emerged, LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre] worked with transport officials on a balanced sector priority note in a low-lying market town.

source_text: AIC [Pusat Integrasi Udara] meminta rincian zona pendaratan yang diperbarui sebelum helikopter diizinkan mendukung komunitas di permukiman dataran banjir.
target_text: The AIC [Air Integration Centre] requested updated landing-zone details before helicopters were cleared to support communities in the floodplain settlements.

source_text: Petugas distrik mengaitkan MASCAS [Insiden Korban Massal] dengan pelepasan kargo bertahap setelah laporan dari wilayah tangkapan rumah sakit timur berubah semalam.
target_text: district officers linked MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] to a phased cargo release after reports from the eastern hospital catchment changed overnight.

source_text: Selama pekerjaan di lokasi jembatan sementara, Mutual Recognition [perjanjian sertifikasi untuk tim USAR] membantu memisahkan tindakan mendesak dari pemantauan rutin.
target_text: During work on the temporary bridge site, Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] helped separate urgent action from routine monitoring.

source_text: Staf pertahanan sipil menerapkan APOD [Pelabuhan Udara Kedatangan] ketika sekelompok kasus demam membuat perencanaan untuk pos komando distrik kurang dapat diprediksi.
target_text: civil defence staff applied APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] when a cluster of fever cases made planning for the district command post less predictable.

source_text: Tim respons meninjau SPOD [Pelabuhan Laut Kedatangan] setelah daftar penerima manfaat yang hilang menunjukkan kelemahan dalam perencanaan untuk jalan pintas perbukitan.
target_text: The response team reviewed SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] after a missing beneficiary list exposed a weakness in planning for the hill road bypass.

source_text: Para insinyur melindungi MSR [Rute Pasokan Utama] dengan memperkuat penyeberangan sementara dan menempatkan tim pengatur lalu lintas di bagian rawan longsor.
target_text: Engineers protected the MSR [Main Supply Route] by reinforcing a temporary crossing and placing traffic control teams at landslide-prone sections.

source_text: Sel perencanaan menggunakan CIQ [Bea Cukai, Imigrasi, dan Karantina] untuk memutuskan apakah kawasan industri yang rusak akibat banjir memerlukan rencana rujukan medis yang lebih jelas.
target_text: The planning cell used CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] to decide whether the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a clearer medical referral plan.

source_text: Untuk koridor logistik barat, MCDA [Aset Militer dan Pertahanan Sipil] memberi tim cara untuk membandingkan kekurangan awak ambulans dengan risiko respons lainnya.
target_text: For the western logistics corridor, MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] gave the team a way to compare a shortage of ambulance crews with other response risks.

source_text: Ringkasan koordinasi membingkai lonjakan mendadak kedatangan ke tempat penampungan melalui HuMOCC [Konsep Koordinasi Operasional Kemanusiaan-Militer] agar para pemimpin dapat menyetujui tugas penyediaan air yang praktis.
target_text: The coordination brief framed a sudden increase in shelter arrivals through HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] so leaders could approve a practical water-supply task.

source_text: Tim meninjau kembali DVI [Identifikasi Korban Bencana] karena ketidakpastian batas berat jalan memengaruhi cara penasihat teknik merencanakan tugas teknik yang lebih realistis.
target_text: The team revisited DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] because uncertain road weight limits affected how engineering advisers planned a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: Catatan lapangan dari LEMA [Otoritas Manajemen Darurat Lokal] memvalidasi perencanaan untuk kota pasar dataran rendah, menghasilkan ringkasan keputusan yang lebih sederhana.
target_text: A field note from LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] validated planning for a low-lying market town, leading to a simpler decision brief.

source_text: Ex COORES [Latihan Respons Terkoordinasi] membentuk rencana rujukan medis yang lebih jelas setelah perencana provinsi memastikan kondisi di klaster tempat penampungan sekolah.
target_text: Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] shaped a clearer medical referral plan once provincial planners confirmed conditions in the school shelter cluster.

source_text: Sel perencanaan menggunakan TTX [Latihan Meja] untuk memutuskan apakah apron kargo bandara memerlukan pembaruan komandan yang lebih singkat.
target_text: The planning cell used TTX [Table-Top Exercise] to decide whether the airport cargo apron needed a shorter commander update.

source_text: Untuk zona irigasi hilir, OPERA CIS [Sistem Informasi Komputer untuk berbagi informasi] memberi tim cara untuk membandingkan pemeriksaan jembatan yang tertunda dengan risiko respons lainnya.
target_text: For the downstream irrigation zone, OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] gave the team a way to compare a delayed bridge inspection with other response risks.

source_text: Ringkasan koordinasi membingkai gorong-gorong yang tersumbat di dekat MSR melalui SASOP [Prosedur Operasi Standar untuk Pengaturan Siaga Regional] agar para pemimpin dapat menyetujui tugas teknik yang lebih realistis.
target_text: The coordination brief framed a blocked culvert near the MSR through SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] so leaders could approve a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: Tim hukum menggunakan SASOP Chapter VI [bagian yang mengatur fasilitasi dan penggunaan aset militer] untuk membahas bagaimana aset militer harus difasilitasi ketika kapasitas sipil kewalahan.
target_text: The legal team used SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] to discuss how military assets should be facilitated when civilian capacity was overwhelmed.

source_text: Tim kesehatan masyarakat menerapkan AADMER [Perjanjian ASEAN tentang Penanggulangan Bencana dan Tanggap Darurat] ketika ketidakpastian batas berat jalan membuat perencanaan untuk jaringan rujukan klinik kurang dapat diprediksi.
target_text: public health teams applied AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] when uncertain road weight limits made planning for the clinic referral network less predictable.

source_text: Desain latihan meminjam pelajaran ARDEX [Latihan Simulasi Tanggap Darurat Bencana Regional ASEAN] tentang waktu sisipan yang realistis, koordinasi lintas batas, dan tekanan tuntutan sektor yang bersamaan.
target_text: The exercise design borrowed ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] lessons on realistic inject timing, cross-border coordination, and the pressure of simultaneous sector demands.

source_text: SME [Pakar Subjek] meninjau laporan ruang operasi distrik dan mengoreksi beberapa asumsi tentang kapasitas lonjakan rumah sakit.
target_text: The SME [Subject Matter Expert] reviewed district operations room reports and corrected several assumptions about hospital surge capacity.

source_text: Selama AAR [Tinjauan Setelah Aksi], peserta mengidentifikasi perbaikan praktis untuk catatan serah terima, pelatihan penghubung, penyaring informasi, dan pelacakan permintaan.
target_text: During the AAR [After Action Review], participants identified practical improvements for handover notes, liaison training, information filters, and request tracking.

source_text: Sel perencanaan menggunakan GenAI [Kecerdasan Buatan Generatif] untuk memutuskan apakah desa-desa nelayan pesisir memerlukan tugas teknik yang lebih realistis.
target_text: The planning cell used GenAI [Generative AI] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: Untuk koridor longsor dataran tinggi, LLM [Model Bahasa Besar] memberi tim cara untuk membandingkan pemeriksaan jembatan yang tertunda dengan risiko respons lainnya.
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, LLM [Large Language Model] gave the team a way to compare a delayed bridge inspection with other response risks.

source_text: Ringkasan koordinasi membingkai gorong-gorong yang tersumbat di dekat MSR melalui Sentinel-1 [program pencitraan satelit] agar para pemimpin dapat menyetujui rencana rujukan medis yang lebih jelas.
target_text: The coordination brief framed a blocked culvert near the MSR through Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] so leaders could approve a clearer medical referral plan.

source_text: Operator radio menerapkan Copernicus [program pencitraan satelit] ketika sekelompok kasus demam membuat perencanaan untuk lokasi jembatan sementara kurang dapat diprediksi.
target_text: radio operators applied Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] when a cluster of fever cases made planning for the temporary bridge site less predictable.

source_text: Sel perencanaan menerapkan Digital Twin [proyek replika virtual yang diusulkan untuk akurasi simulasi] ketika umpan balik komunitas membuat keputusan penugasan rutin menjadi lebih rumit.
target_text: The planning cell applied Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] when community feedback made routine tasking decisions more complicated.

source_text: Dengan menggabungkan TTX virtual dan latihan pergerakan lapangan, Hybrid Exercise [model yang menggabungkan TTX virtual dan komponen FTX fisik] menguji pengambilan keputusan dan prosedur penerimaan praktis dalam satu skenario.
target_text: By combining a virtual TTX with field movement drills, the Hybrid Exercise [Model combining virtual TTX and physical FTX components] tested decision-making and practical reception procedures in one scenario.

source_text: Setelah gambaran akses berubah, perencana menerapkan Interoperability [kemampuan berbagai sistem untuk bertukar data] untuk menjaga keputusan penugasan tetap konsisten dengan kebutuhan yang telah diverifikasi.
target_text: After the access picture changed, planners applied Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] to keep tasking decisions consistent with verified needs.

target_text: JOCCA helped regional partners translate situational awareness into practical support options for the affected state.

source_text: Tim SCDF menekankan akuntabilitas petugas respons selama operasi penyelamatan panjang di bangunan yang tidak stabil dan penuh puing.
target_text: SCDF teams emphasized responder accountability during long rescue operations in unstable and debris-filled buildings.

source_text: VINASARCOM meminta provinsi membedakan permintaan penyelamatan jiwa yang mendesak dari kebutuhan pemulihan sebelum mengajukan kebutuhan bantuan.
target_text: VINASARCOM asked provinces to distinguish urgent life-saving requests from recovery needs before submitting assistance requirements.

source_text: Proyeksi banjir VDDMA membantu perencana evakuasi memutuskan komunitas mana yang harus bergerak sebelum malam tiba.
target_text: VDDMA flood projections helped evacuation planners decide which communities should move before nightfall.

source_text: Unit teknik VPA memulihkan akses ke klinik pedesaan setelah longsor memblokir satu-satunya jalan.
target_text: VPA engineering units restored access to a rural clinic after landslides blocked the only road.

source_text: MARD memperingatkan bahwa penilaian kerusakan pertanian harus dimulai sejak dini untuk mendukung keputusan pemulihan mata pencaharian kemudian.
target_text: MARD warned that agricultural damage assessments should begin early to support later livelihood recovery decisions.

source_text: MOT membuka kembali jalan akses sekunder setelah para insinyur memastikan jalan itu dapat mendukung kendaraan darurat.
target_text: MOT reopened a secondary access road after engineers confirmed it could support emergency vehicles.

source_text: MOH mengoordinasikan pemindahan pasien ketika rumah sakit distrik melaporkan kekurangan tempat tidur trauma dan pasokan oksigen.
target_text: MOH coordinated patient transfers when district hospitals reported shortages of trauma beds and oxygen supplies.

source_text: Mitra DRRP mengusulkan pengaitan pelajaran latihan dengan perbaikan kesiapsiagaan untuk sekolah, klinik, dan otoritas komune.
target_text: DRRP partners proposed linking exercise lessons to preparedness improvements for schools, clinics, and commune authorities.

source_text: Hibah QPT mendukung tim komunitas yang memelihara rambu evakuasi, pompa lokal, dan alat penyelamatan dasar.
target_text: QPT grants supported community teams that maintained evacuation signs, local pumps, and basic rescue tools.

source_text: Staf penelusuran keluarga VNRC membantu kerabat yang terpisah bertukar informasi melalui meja pendaftaran tempat penampungan.
target_text: VNRC family tracing staff helped separated relatives exchange information through shelter registration desks.

source_text: VAMS merekomendasikan pemicu yang lebih jelas untuk redistribusi ambulans ketika beberapa rumah sakit meminta pemindahan secara bersamaan.
target_text: VAMS recommended clearer triggers for ambulance redistribution when several hospitals request transfers simultaneously.

source_text: Pemimpin WoG meninjau risiko kesehatan, pembatasan transportasi, kekhawatiran ketahanan pangan, dan prioritas teknik dalam satu rapat.
target_text: WoG leaders reviewed health risks, transport restrictions, food security concerns, and engineering priorities in one meeting.

source_text: NDMO meminta mitra menyertakan jadwal pengerahan, kebutuhan keberlanjutan, dan keterbatasan dalam setiap tawaran bantuan.
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to include deployment timelines, sustainment needs, and limitations in every assistance offer.

source_text: Petugas CMCoord membandingkan prioritas bantuan dengan kapabilitas militer sebelum merekomendasikan tugas untuk helikopter dan unit teknik.
target_text: CMCoord officers compared relief priorities with military capabilities before recommending tasks for helicopters and engineering units.

source_text: Koordinasi Mil-Mil membantu pasukan mitra mendekonflik frekuensi radio dan area persiapan sebelum pergerakan lapangan dimulai.
target_text: Mil-Mil coordination helped partner forces deconflict radio frequencies and staging areas before field movement began.

source_text: Pengarahan Civ-Mil membaik ketika lembaga kemanusiaan menerima pembaruan yang dapat diprediksi tentang waktu dan rute konvoi militer.
target_text: Civ-Mil briefings improved when humanitarian agencies received predictable updates on military convoy timing and routes.

source_text: AS [Affected State] menolak pasokan yang tidak diminta yang akan menghabiskan ruang gudang tanpa memenuhi kebutuhan kemanusiaan segera.
target_text: The AS [Affected State] declined unsolicited supplies that would have consumed warehouse space without meeting immediate humanitarian needs.

source_text: MNCC menggunakan RFA yang telah divalidasi untuk menugaskan dukungan militer asing sambil menghindari duplikasi kemampuan lokal.
target_text: The MNCC used validated RFAs to assign foreign military support while avoiding duplication of local capability.

source_text: Staf EOC beralih ke komunikasi cadangan setelah kerusakan akibat badai mengganggu konektivitas internet di beberapa distrik.
target_text: EOC staff shifted to backup communications after storm damage disrupted internet connectivity in several districts.

source_text: Proses RFA memastikan bahwa setiap aset yang diminta menangani kesenjangan yang telah diverifikasi, bukan kekhawatiran umum.
target_text: The RFA process ensured that every requested asset addressed a verified gap rather than a general concern.

source_text: COP menampilkan status jalan, kapasitas rumah sakit, hunian tempat penampungan, kendala logistik, dan tawaran bantuan yang tertunda.
target_text: The COP displayed road status, hospital capacity, shelter occupancy, logistics constraints, and pending assistance offers.

source_text: Komandan SAR menghentikan sementara operasi sungai ketika kondisi cuaca membuat pencarian malam terlalu berbahaya bagi petugas respons.
target_text: SAR commanders paused river operations when weather conditions made night search too dangerous for responders.

source_text: Tim USAR menandai area yang telah dibersihkan secara konsisten agar kru yang datang dapat memahami bahaya tersisa dan prioritas pencarian.
target_text: USAR teams marked cleared areas consistently so incoming crews could understand remaining hazards and search priorities.

source_text: Koordinator MSAR melibatkan komunitas nelayan karena pengetahuan lokal membantu menyempurnakan perkiraan hanyutan dan area pencarian garis pantai.
target_text: MSAR coordinators included fishing communities because local knowledge helped refine drift estimates and shoreline search areas.

source_text: Spesialis CBRE meninjau label kontainer dan pola drainase sebelum membuka kembali rute di dekat zona industri.
target_text: CBRE specialists reviewed container labels and drainage patterns before reopening a route near the industrial zone.

source_text: Pelacak IOI menunjukkan bahwa ketersediaan bahan bakar, kemacetan helikopter, dan kepadatan tempat penampungan memerlukan keputusan tingkat senior.
target_text: The IOI tracker showed that fuel availability, helicopter congestion, and shelter crowding required senior-level decisions.

source_text: Mitra WASH memprioritaskan klorinasi, pemeliharaan jamban, dan pesan higiene setelah laporan air tidak aman meningkat.
target_text: WASH partners prioritized chlorination, latrine maintenance, and hygiene messaging after reports of unsafe water increased.

source_text: Perencanaan NFI memperhitungkan ukuran rumah tangga, kebutuhan disabilitas, perawatan bayi, dan keluarga tanpa peralatan memasak.
target_text: NFI planning accounted for household size, disability needs, infant care, and families without cooking equipment.

source_text: HOC mengumpulkan umpan balik komunitas yang tidak terlihat di papan logistik dan pergerakan MNCC.
target_text: The HOC collected community feedback that was not visible in the MNCC logistics and movement boards.

source_text: Perencana LCC mengurutkan kargo agar pasokan medis, barang pengolahan air, dan bahan bakar bergerak sebelum material prioritas lebih rendah.
target_text: LCC planners sequenced cargo so medical supplies, water treatment items, and fuel moved before lower-priority materials.

source_text: AIC mewajibkan tim drone mengajukan rencana penerbangan karena helikopter beroperasi di dekat lembah yang sama.
target_text: The AIC required drone teams to submit flight plans because helicopters were operating near the same valley.

source_text: Prosedur MASCAS membantu rumah sakit mengoordinasikan area triase, rute pemindahan, dan pelacakan pasien selama latihan.
target_text: MASCAS procedures helped hospitals coordinate triage areas, transfer routes, and patient tracking during the exercise.

source_text: Mutual Recognition mengurangi keterlambatan administratif bagi tim penyelamat tersertifikasi sambil mempertahankan kewenangan negara tuan rumah atas penugasan.
target_text: Mutual Recognition reduced administrative delays for certified rescue teams while preserving host-nation authority over tasking.

source_text: APOD membutuhkan lebih banyak forklift setelah beberapa penerbangan bantuan tiba dengan kargo berpallet yang memerlukan penanganan mekanis.
target_text: The APOD needed more forklifts after multiple relief flights arrived with palletized cargo requiring mechanical handling.

source_text: Koordinasi SPOD menjadi penting ketika kapal yang membawa alat berat tiba saat operasi pelabuhan komersial masih terganggu.
target_text: SPOD coordination became important when vessels carrying heavy equipment arrived while commercial port operations were still disrupted.

source_text: Penilaian MSR mempertimbangkan kekuatan jembatan, paparan longsor, ketersediaan bahan bakar, dan titik istirahat yang aman.
target_text: The MSR assessment considered bridge strength, landslide exposure, fuel availability, and safe rest points.

source_text: Koordinasi CIQ membantu tim yang masuk meloloskan perangkat komunikasi, pasokan medis, dan alat penyelamatan tanpa penundaan yang tidak perlu.
target_text: CIQ coordination helped incoming teams clear communications gear, medical supplies, and rescue tools without unnecessary delay.

source_text: Perencana MCDA meninjau tugas dukungan setiap hari untuk memastikan bantuan militer tetap diperlukan dan proporsional.
target_text: MCDA planners reviewed support tasks daily to ensure military assistance remained necessary and proportionate.

source_text: Konsep HuMOCC membantu petugas respons membahas penghubung, berbagi informasi, dan dukungan tugas tanpa mencampuradukkan koordinasi dengan komando.
target_text: HuMOCC concepts helped responders discuss liaison, information sharing, and task support without confusing coordination with command.

source_text: Prosedur DVI mencakup pengelolaan informasi keluarga, perlindungan bukti, pertimbangan budaya, dan koordinasi dengan polisi lokal.
target_text: DVI procedures included family information management, evidence protection, cultural considerations, and coordination with local police.

source_text: Pejabat LEMA melaporkan bahwa tempat penampungan informal membutuhkan penerangan, penyimpanan air, dan dukungan pendaftaran yang lebih jelas.
target_text: LEMA officials reported that informal shelters needed lighting, water storage, and clearer registration support.

source_text: Pengendali Ex COORES memperkenalkan gangguan komunikasi mendadak untuk menguji saluran pelaporan cadangan dan kemampuan adaptasi pimpinan.
target_text: Ex COORES controllers introduced a sudden communications outage to test backup reporting channels and leadership adaptability.

source_text: TTX mengungkapkan bahwa ringkasan keputusan membutuhkan opsi yang lebih jelas ketika beberapa sektor meminta aset transportasi yang langka.
target_text: The TTX revealed that decision briefs needed clearer options when multiple sectors requested scarce transport assets.

source_text: Entri OPERA CIS diperbarui sebelum setiap rapat agar para pemimpin tidak bertindak berdasarkan permintaan yang sudah usang.
target_text: OPERA CIS entries were updated before each meeting so leaders would not act on outdated requests.

source_text: Langkah aktivasi SASOP memandu urutan dari permintaan nasional hingga koordinasi regional ASEAN.
target_text: SASOP activation steps guided the sequence from national request through ASEAN regional coordination.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI membantu peserta membahas persyaratan bea cukai, pergerakan, dan fasilitasi untuk aset militer.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped participants discuss customs, movement, and facilitation requirements for military assets.

source_text: Komitmen AADMER mendukung berbagi informasi dan kerja sama yang tepat waktu di antara otoritas penanggulangan bencana ASEAN.
target_text: AADMER commitments supported timely information sharing and cooperation among ASEAN disaster management authorities.

source_text: Pelajaran ARDEX membentuk titik tekanan yang melibatkan perhatian media, keterlambatan logistik, dan prioritas sektor yang bersaing.
target_text: ARDEX lessons shaped the pressure points involving media attention, logistics delays, and competing sector priorities.

source_text: SME operasi kesehatan merekomendasikan pengaitan surveilans penyakit secara langsung dengan prosedur rujukan dan isolasi.
target_text: The SME on health operations recommended linking disease surveillance directly to referral and isolation procedures.

source_text: Fasilitator AAR meminta setiap sel mengidentifikasi satu perbaikan proses dan satu praktik yang layak dipertahankan.
target_text: AAR facilitators asked each cell to identify one process improvement and one practice worth keeping.

source_text: GenAI menghasilkan draf catatan pengarahan dari laporan panjang, tetapi staf menghapus pernyataan yang tidak didukung atau ambigu.
target_text: GenAI produced draft briefing notes from long reports, but staff removed unsupported or ambiguous statements.

source_text: LLM membantu membandingkan pembaruan multibahasa agar tim informasi dapat menghindari salah menerjemahkan kategori operasional.
target_text: The LLM helped compare multilingual updates so the information team could avoid mistranslating operational categories.

source_text: Produk Sentinel-1 memberi perencana keyakinan bahwa rute utara tetap tergenang meskipun akses darat terbatas.
target_text: Sentinel-1 products gave planners confidence that the northern route remained flooded despite limited ground access.

source_text: Lapisan Copernicus ditambahkan ke COP untuk memandu tim verifikasi lapangan menuju permukiman yang paling terdampak.
target_text: Copernicus layers were added to the COP to guide field verification teams toward the hardest-hit settlements.

source_text: Digital Twin menunjukkan bahwa jembatan sementara dapat mengurangi waktu tempuh ambulans lebih banyak daripada dukungan udara tambahan.
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that a temporary bridge could reduce ambulance travel time more than additional air support.

source_text: Perencanaan Hybrid Exercise mengharuskan pengaturan waktu sisipan kebijakan jarak jauh dengan kegiatan lapangan di APOD simulasi.
target_text: Hybrid Exercise planning required timing remote policy injects with field activities at the simulated APOD.

source_text: Tantangan Interoperability muncul ketika mitra menggunakan format koordinat berbeda dan nama informal untuk desa yang sama.
target_text: Interoperability challenges appeared when partners used different coordinate formats and informal names for the same villages.

source_text: Information Overload muncul kembali selama sisipan gempa susulan sampai laporan disaring melalui meja manajemen informasi.
target_text: Information Overload returned during the aftershock inject until reports were filtered through the information management desk.

source_text: ToR mengharuskan petugas penghubung menyampaikan pembaruan ringkas, mengidentifikasi hambatan, dan menandai keputusan yang diperlukan dari pimpinan.
target_text: The ToR required liaison officers to submit concise updates, identify blockers, and flag decisions needed from leaders.

source_text: Persetujuan CONOPS bergantung pada asumsi tentang jendela cuaca, akses pelabuhan, kondisi keamanan, dan prioritas bantuan.
target_text: CONOPS approval depended on assumptions about weather windows, port access, security conditions, and relief priorities.

source_text: NFP memberi tahu mitra ketika tim medis diterima tetapi pakaian sumbangan tambahan ditolak.
target_text: The NFP notified partners when medical teams were accepted but additional donated clothing was declined.

source_text: Tim HADR menyesuaikan rencana distribusi setelah umpan balik komunitas menunjukkan bahwa satu rute secara teknis terbuka tetapi tidak aman.
target_text: HADR teams adjusted distribution plans after community feedback showed that one route was technically open but unsafe.

source_text: Changi RHCC mempertahankan ikhtisar regional atas aset yang ditawarkan, dikerahkan, tidak tersedia, atau menunggu penugasan.
target_text: The Changi RHCC maintained a regional overview of assets that were offered, deployed, unavailable, or awaiting tasking.

source_text: Situasi di dusun-dusun pulau sungai mengharuskan US INDOPACOM menjelaskan apakah meja penerimaan yang kelebihan beban mengubah urutan respons.
target_text: The situation in river-island hamlets required US INDOPACOM to clarify whether an overloaded reception desk changed the response sequence.

source_text: Pengamat CFE-DM menyoroti bagaimana agenda rapat yang disiplin meningkatkan keputusan selama periode latihan bertekanan tinggi.
target_text: CFE-DM observers highlighted how disciplined meeting agendas improved decisions during the high-pressure exercise period.

source_text: AHA Centre membantu mengomunikasikan opsi dukungan ASEAN tanpa menciptakan kanal permintaan paralel bagi pemerintah terdampak.
target_text: The AHA Centre helped communicate ASEAN support options without creating parallel request channels for the affected government.

source_text: UN OCHA mendukung ringkasan prioritas bersama yang mengaitkan kebutuhan kemanusiaan dengan kapasitas sektor dan kendala operasional.
target_text: UN OCHA supported a shared priorities brief that linked humanitarian needs to sector capacity and operational constraints.

source_text: Tim ASEAN-ERAT merekomendasikan penilaian lanjutan di desa-desa tempat pergerakan penduduk tidak jelas setelah badai.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT teams recommended further assessment in villages where population movement was unclear after the storm.

source_text: Fasilitator ACMC membantu peserta membahas ketegangan antara dukungan militer cepat dan independensi kemanusiaan.
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants discuss the tension between rapid military support and humanitarian independence.

source_text: Pemodelan PDC menunjukkan bahwa jalan pesisir dapat banjir lagi jika pasang tinggi bertepatan dengan hujan yang kembali turun.
target_text: PDC modelling showed that coastal roads could flood again if high tide coincided with renewed rainfall.

source_text: WHO meninjau tata letak tempat penampungan dan merekomendasikan jarak yang lebih baik, kapasitas isolasi, akses sanitasi, dan prosedur rujukan kesehatan.
target_text: WHO reviewed shelter layouts and recommended better spacing, isolation capacity, sanitation access, and health referral procedures.

source_text: WFP menyiapkan rute kontingensi untuk pengiriman pangan jika banjir baru menutup jalan akses gudang utama.
target_text: WFP prepared contingency routing for food deliveries in case renewed flooding closed the main warehouse access road.

source_text: ISCG sepakat menggabungkan pembaruan sektor menjadi satu catatan ringkas alih-alih membuat permintaan terpisah yang tumpang tindih.
target_text: The ISCG agreed to combine sector updates into one concise note rather than producing separate overlapping requests.

source_text: USAID BHA memprioritaskan mitra yang dapat menunjukkan koordinasi lokal, kebutuhan yang telah dinilai, dan kapasitas pengiriman yang realistis.
target_text: USAID BHA prioritized partners that could show local coordination, assessed needs, and realistic delivery capacity.

source_text: Peserta ADMM-Plus mencatat bahwa pelatihan penghubung sama pentingnya dengan peralatan untuk dukungan HADR regional yang efektif.
target_text: ADMM-Plus participants noted that liaison training is as important as equipment for effective regional HADR support.

source_text: EWG on HADR merekomendasikan prosedur serah terima yang lebih jelas bagi petugas penghubung yang bergilir melalui sel koordinasi multinasional.
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended clearer handover procedures for liaison officers rotating through multinational coordination cells.

source_text: Penandaan INSARAG membantu kru yang datang mengenali ruangan yang telah digeledah, bahaya yang teridentifikasi, dan lokasi yang memerlukan pekerjaan teknis lanjutan.
target_text: INSARAG markings helped incoming crews recognize searched rooms, identified hazards, and locations requiring further technical work.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat mengarsipkan keluaran latihan agar perencana masa depan dapat membandingkan kemajuan dengan rekomendasi sebelumnya.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat archived exercise outputs so future planners could compare progress against earlier recommendations.

source_text: Laporan kesiapan AMRG on HADR mencakup jadwal pengerahan, batas keberlanjutan, kapabilitas spesialis, dan kontak koordinasi.
target_text: AMRG on HADR readiness reports included deployment timelines, sustainment limits, specialist capabilities, and coordination contacts.

source_text: Personel SAF memberi saran tentang penerimaan lapangan udara, pergerakan kargo, dan koordinasi antara staf penerbangan dan otoritas sipil.
target_text: SAF personnel advised on airfield reception, cargo movement, and coordination between aviation staff and civilian authorities.

source_text: Perencana teknik PLA memberikan batasan peralatan agar MNCC dapat menetapkan tugas perbaikan jalan yang realistis.
target_text: PLA engineering planners provided equipment limitations so the MNCC could assign realistic road repair tasks.

source_text: JOCCA membantu mencegah duplikasi dengan membandingkan tawaran regional dengan prioritas nasional dan permintaan bantuan yang tertunda.
target_text: JOCCA helped prevent duplication by comparing regional offers with national priorities and pending assistance requests.

source_text: Mentor SCDF meninjau prosedur serah terima korban dengan tim lokal sebelum latihan struktur runtuh dimulai.
target_text: SCDF mentors reviewed casualty handover procedures with local teams before the collapsed-structure drill began.

source_text: VINASARCOM mewajibkan satu daftar kebutuhan terbaru sebelum permintaan bantuan internasional baru diterbitkan.
target_text: VINASARCOM required a single updated needs list before any new international assistance request was issued.

source_text: Pembaruan VDDMA menunjukkan bahwa satu bagian sungai tetap di atas tingkat bahaya meskipun total curah hujan menurun.
target_text: VDDMA updates showed that one river section remained above danger level despite falling rainfall totals.

source_text: Truk VPA mengangkut kargo bantuan ke hub depan setelah MOT memastikan rute sekunder terbuka.
target_text: VPA trucks transported relief cargo to a forward hub after MOT confirmed that the secondary route was open.

source_text: MARD melaporkan bahwa pencegahan penyakit ternak akan menjadi penting setelah operasi evakuasi stabil.
target_text: MARD reported that livestock disease prevention would become important once evacuation operations stabilized.

source_text: MOT memperingatkan perencana konvoi bahwa jembatan yang diperbaiki dapat menopang ambulans tetapi bukan truk kargo bermuatan penuh.
target_text: MOT warned convoy planners that a repaired bridge could support ambulances but not fully loaded cargo trucks.

source_text: MOH meminta koordinasi tambahan dengan WHO tentang surveilans penyakit di tempat penampungan dan prosedur rujukan pasien.
target_text: MOH requested additional coordination with WHO on shelter disease surveillance and patient referral procedures.
